Electrical Engineer Job at Mikano International Limited




        
    

        
        Mikano International Limited is a Nigerian company in the power generation, real estate and construction sectors. This company offers sales, maintenance, assembly and distribution of power generation products, real estate development, and sales of construction equipment.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Electrical Engineer
Job Location: Ogba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of diesel generators ranging from 20kVA and above.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Install, commission, and test diesel generators (20kVA–500kVA)
	Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance.
	Diagnose and repair electrical faults in generators, control panels, ATS/AMF systems.
	Perform load testing, performance checks, and system inspections
	Maintain accurate service and maintenance records.
	Ensure compliance with HSE, company policies, and Nigerian electrical standards.
	Provide technical support to clients and respond to emergency breakdowns.
	Work closely with mechanical engineers and field technicians.


Requirements


	HND / BSc in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
	Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with diesel generators (20kVA–and above).
	Professional Qualification is an added advantage.
	Experience: Good years of experience in installation of generator set.
	Strong knowledge of generator electrical systems and control panels.
	Experience with ATS/AMF panels and basic synchronization.
	Ability to read electrical diagrams and troubleshoot faults.
	Knowledge of earthing, load management, and protection systems.


Benefits


	Transport Allowance, Feeding, Leave allowance, HMO & Pension.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Human Resource Development Partner Job at Total Data Limited




        
    

        
        Total Data Limited is a management consultancy firm specializing in the provision of Human Resources and Manpower solutions to its’ clients across Nigeria. We focus on providing additional and exceptional services through value added, and end-to-end HR services to our clients; helping them maximize and build operational efficiency.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Development Partner

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time

Duties and Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Serve as the primary interface between TDL and the assigned Clients.
	Identify client’s recruitment needs, strategic competences and forecast the critical skills requirements.
	Implement recruitment plans to hire/fill vacant positions in area of coverage.
	Identify training needs using combination of indicators to enable Learning & Development plan and organize for such trainings.
	Attend people meetings with the various departments for the review of the training plan/curriculum
	Provide support and professional advice to line managers in the implementation of people processes (appraisals, coaching, training, disciplinary etc)
	Monitor the grievance/disciplinary issues/process within areas of coverage and provide necessary support
	Embark on periodic visits to Clients offices/branches for on-the-spot assessment of business situations and HR issues
	Ensure new hires meet specific target performance level and proper documentation prior to confirmation
	Generate monthly/quarterly/annual performance, activity and HR analysis reports
	Maintain the security of all information entrusted to you and all members of staff
	Comply with the principles and policies in the handbook, policy manuals and SOPs
	Other official tasks assigned by the HR Manager
	Ensure prompt payment from clients to reduce cost of funds.
	Act as a champion for employee engagement initiatives, working closely with managers and teams to foster a positive work environment and enhance employee morale.


Key Performance Indicators


	Revenue Growth
	Cost Reduction
	Audit Defect Rate Compliance
	Ensure prompt reimbursement from assigned client
	Employee Satisfaction & Turn-over rate
	Training
	Turn-around time, Issue Resolution & Quality Rate
	Implementation of Efficient & Effective Policies, Procedures & Processes
	Strategic initiatives
	Completeness in Employee Documentation
	Confirmations on Due Date/ Staff Documentation
	Customer satisfaction levels


Requirements
Educational Qualification:


	Minimum Education:  First Degree is mandatory.
	Higher degrees/Professional certifications


Experience:


	Minimum experience – 5 years’ experience (with at least 3 years in HR generalist function)


Key Competencies Requirements:
Knowledge:


	Industry knowledge
	HR policies and procedures
	Labor laws
	Industrial relations
	Business performance
	HR data base systems
	HR analysis/analytics


Skill/Competencies:


	Collaborative and supportive style of working
	Resourcefulness & Resilience
	Empathy
	Accuracy and attention to detail
	Excellent time management and organisation skills
	Interpersonal skills
	IT Literacy
	Excellent Communications skills (written and oral) with strong business and customer focus
	Reasoning and Analytical Skills
	People management
	Supervisory skills


Salary
Competitive

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Background Checks & Verification Specialist",
  "description": "Estrada International Staffing Solutions (EISS) is a leading HR consulting and talent solutions firm dedicated to helping organizations attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent. We provide comprehensive human resource services across recruitment, outsourcing, background verification, and HR advisory, ensuring our clients achieve sustainable business growth through people excellence.

With a commitment to quality, speed, and professionalism, we partner with organizations of all sizes, ranging from multinationals to indigenous SMEs; across diverse industries. Our tailored solutions are designed to simplify HR processes, enhance workforce capability, and deliver measurable impact.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Background Checks &amp; Verification Specialist

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Level: Mid-Level
Department: Background Checks &amp; Verifications
Reports to: Chief&nbsp;Recruitment Officer (CRO)
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

How You&#39;ll Make an Impact


	We are looking for a rare, high-performance hybrid: a Background Checks &amp; Verification Specialist who is equal parts investigative operator and strategic growth hunter.
